text: England beat Australia by 135 runs in Adelaide to level the ODI series 1-1, with Tom Banton's century and four wickets for Gus Atkinson; the decider is in Hobart.
The Mets are due to meet free agent ace Tarik Skubal in California this week, alongside the Dodgers, Blue Jays and Padres.
The Grand Slam of Curling National opens Tuesday in Sydney, Nova Scotia, with 16 men's and 16 women's teams and every event on ESPN+.
Stephen Bunting is out of the Grand Slam of Darts after losing 5-2 to Cameron Menzies, who won Group D.
Kyren Wilson won the Champion of Champions 10-8 over Chris Wakelin, extending a title run that includes the Northern Ireland Open and International Championship.
Yokozuna Hoshoryu fell to 4-5 on day nine in Fukuoka, beaten by Atamifuji, while Onosato, Kirishima, Atamifuji and Wakamotoharu lead on 8-1.
